From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps - Redwood pilot (FinovateBank)

Alex - thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can keep momentum toward a POC by end of June.

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary use case: automated customer support triage + response suggestions for digital channels.
- Current pilot scope: 3 channels, ~500k messages/year (peak concurrency estimates: small).
- Decision criteria: latency (<500ms p50), predictable cost per 1k requests, SOC2 compliance, data residency in US.
- Economic buyer: Diane Park (CFO) - Alex to confirm and intro.
- Procurement/legal: procurement@finovatebank.com; legal will require SOC2 Type II evidence and standard vendor agreement redlines.

Proposed next steps
1) I'll send an updated MAP + SoW stub (attached) and an ROI one-pager we can use in your internal deck.
2) Alex to intro Diane + procurement (email thread) so we can align requirements and timeline.
3) We'll run a short security review: SOC2 summary attached; if you need the full report we can provide it under NDA.
4) Technical touchpoint: Priyom (SE) to run a focused demo for Diane + technical procurement to show latency/kv-cache behavior.

Champion enablement (talk tracks + quick ROI bullets you can use)
- Talk track: "Redwood reduces manual ticket triage by automating initial triage and suggested responses, cutting first-response time by ~60%."
- ROI metric (example): 40% reduction in manual triage time across the pilot scope = estimated $200k/year run-rate savings (see attached spreadsheet for assumptions).
- Objections: security - we have a SOC2 Type II + regional deployment options; procurement - we support standard redlines and can provide scoped SOW for pilot.

Suggested timeline (target)
- Week of 5/3: Intro to Diane + procurement
- Week of 5/10: Security questionnaire + initial redlines
- Week of 5/17: SE demo for Diane + tech team
- Week of 6/21: Pilot kicks off

Attachments: Redwood_MVP_SOW_v1.pdf, Redwood_ROI_one-pager.xlsx, SOC2_summary.pdf

Thanks - happy to adjust. If Diane's schedule is tight, list a couple of 30-min windows and we'll make the demo concise.

Marissa Cole

Diane / Alex - thanks for the fast reply, Diane great to e-meet you. I've attached the SoW stub and ROI page and included the top security controls below for quick reference.

Top security controls (summary for Diane)
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit; AES-256 encryption at rest for customer data where required.
- Access controls: RBAC + SSO/SAML integration and per-team API keys; audit logging for all admin actions.
- Logging & monitoring: retained audit logs (90 days by default, configurable), and trace-level metrics we can ship to your SIEM.

Alex / Diane / Marissa - happy to run the demo. A few quick technical clarifications ahead of the meeting so I can tailor the demo:
- Data flow: will FinovateBank want message text persisted in our long-term storage for evaluation, or prefer ephemeral processing with only logs retained?
- Expected peak concurrent requests during pilot (helps set batch sizing): can you confirm a peak concurrency estimate?
- Security scope: SOC2 Summary attached is accurate; full report can be shared under NDA. For data residency we can provision US-only hosting for the pilot.

If Diane confirms the intro slot for 5/12 09:00 PT I'll prepare a 15-120 minute demo covering: latency p50/p95, KV cache warm vs cold behavior, and example prompts + guardrails.

Thanks - looking forward to it.
